t: Hakkasan is a Cantonese restaurant and hospitality group that began in London. You're looking at the flagship brand, which serves modern Cantonese cooking alongside a Western upscale dining experience. The first restaurant opened in 2001, founded by Alan Yau. He's the same restaurateur who brought the Wagamama noodle chain to Britain and later created Yauatcha. Born in Sha Tau Kok in Hong Kong, he is of Hakka ethnicity, and his family moved to King's Lynn in Norfolk in 1975. The original Hakkasan Group ran from the first restaurant until 2021 and was re-established in 2025.
